# Daily Crossword

> A free crossword puzzle releases every day at 6 AM Eastern Time. Today's
> puzzle is served at the site root, and the full archive of past puzzles is
> available at `/puzzles/YYYY-MM-DD`. Each puzzle is an immutable 10x10 grid
> with across and down clues, a solution, hints, and an optional theme.

## Who this is for

- **Humans:** play today's grid or pick any date in the archive.
- **Search engines & AI models:** daily puzzles are unique, dated, and
  archiveable, so each `/puzzles/YYYY-MM-DD` URL is a stable citation.

## Key URLs

- Today's puzzle: https://playdailycrossword.com/
- Archive example: https://playdailycrossword.com/puzzles/2026-09-07
- Site map: https://playdailycrossword.com/sitemap.xml

## How the puzzle day works

The "current" puzzle rolls over at 6:00 AM Eastern Time (not midnight). Before
6 AM ET the previous day's puzzle is still considered today's.

## Notes

- Puzzles after 2026-09-01 are available; there is no archive before that date.
- The whole site is a JavaScript single-page application, but every dated
  path is a stable, shareable URL.
